howToFind.question: How to check who unfollowed you on Instagram without app?
howToFind.answer: SafeUnfollow reads the export Meta gives you, so you need neither an app nor your password. Open Meta Accounts Center › Create export › Select your profile › Choose "Export to device" › Select only "Followers and following" › Set date range to "All time" › Set format to JSON. Then select the ZIP here.

whoDoesntFollowBack.question: Who doesn't follow me back on Instagram?
whoDoesntFollowBack.answer: SafeUnfollow shows who doesn't follow you back by comparing the two lists in your Instagram export. Accounts you follow that don't follow you appear under the "Not following back" filter. The analysis is free, SafeUnfollow never asks for your Instagram login, and the file stays in your browser.

relatedLink.text: Who doesn't follow you back, step by step

pendingSent.question: How do I see the follow requests I sent on Instagram?
pendingSent.answer: SafeUnfollow lists every follow request you sent that was never accepted, read from pending_follow_requests.json (or .html) in your export. Instagram's app has no screen for them. Select your export here and the "Pending request" filter shows the whole list at once.

mutuals.question: How do I find my mutual followers on Instagram?
mutuals.answer: SafeUnfollow counts an account as mutual when it appears in both lists of your export, following and followers. It checks every row of the export rather than a sample. It works for your own account only and cannot compare two other people's profiles.

relatedLink.text: Your mutual followers, from your own export

withoutDownload.question: Can I check Instagram unfollowers without data download or apps?
withoutDownload.answer: No. Instagram has no unfollower list, so you either compare your lists by hand or use the official data download. SafeUnfollow does the second for you. The analysis is free, and SafeUnfollow never asks for your Instagram password or login.

relatedLink.text: Learn how to get your data

privacy.question: How does Instagram unfollower tracker work without login?
privacy.answer: SafeUnfollow works without a login because it reads your official Instagram data export in your browser, where the export stays. Our analytics record page views and the export's account count and size, never a username. You can switch them off in the footer.

safety.question: Is it safe to use Instagram unfollower tracker apps?
safety.answer: Yes, when the app reads your official Instagram export and never asks for your password. Apps that want your password break Instagram's Terms of Service. SafeUnfollow reads only the ZIP from Instagram's data download tool and has no password field.

dataIncluded.question: What data does Instagram include in my data download file?
dataIncluded.answer: Instagram's data download ZIP holds your profile, followers, following, comments, posts, messages, saved items and more. SafeUnfollow needs two files from it: followers_1.json (your followers) and following.json (who you follow), or their .html versions. It compares them to find unfollowers and accounts that don't follow back.

zipFile.question: What is Instagram data download and why use it?
zipFile.answer: Instagram's data download, in Meta Accounts Center, is Meta's official tool for exporting your account information, including your followers and following lists. It gets you that data without giving your password to anyone. SafeUnfollow reads this export and nothing else.

htmlExport.question: I exported HTML instead of JSON. Do I need to export again?
htmlExport.answer: No. SafeUnfollow already reads both formats. HTML exports also work, but JSON is the format we read most reliably, so it's still what the guide recommends. Select the ZIP you already have.

accountSafety.question: Will my Instagram account be safe using this tracker?
accountSafety.answer: Yes. SafeUnfollow never signs in to your Instagram account and cannot act inside it. You download the ZIP from Instagram yourself and select it here, where your browser reads it. Apps that ask for your password and scrape your data break Instagram's Terms of Service.

notAffiliated.question: Is SafeUnfollow.app related to safeunfollow.com or to a browser extension called SafeUnfollow?
notAffiliated.answer: SafeUnfollow is the web app at safeunfollow.app. SafeUnfollow.app is not affiliated with safeunfollow.com or with any browser extension named SafeUnfollow. We do not publish a browser extension. Nothing we publish acts inside your Instagram account or asks for your Instagram login.

downloadTime.question: How long does it take to receive my Instagram data download?
downloadTime.answer: Meta usually emails your data within 5-30 minutes, and larger accounts or busy periods can take a few hours. Once you have the ZIP, SafeUnfollow reads it in your own browser rather than on a server, so there is no queue. Bigger exports take longer to read than small ones.

scale.question: What size Instagram account export can you analyze?
scale.answer: SafeUnfollow was tested on a synthetic export of 1,000,000 accounts: about 21 seconds from choosing the file to results, in desktop Chrome (November 2026). That was one desktop run, and no phone has been tested at that size. Columnar storage and bitsets keep filtering responsive as the list grows.

free.question: Are there free Instagram unfollower trackers?
free.answer: Yes. SafeUnfollow's analysis is free: every badge, filter and account, with no signup and no limit. The only paid item is exporting your filtered list as a file, a one-time unlock with the price shown on the button. Viewing the list is always free. The code is open source (MIT).

analyzeData.question: How do I analyze my Instagram data download to find unfollowers?
analyzeData.answer: SafeUnfollow unpacks your Instagram ZIP in your browser and compares your follower and following lists. Select the file here to see unfollowers, accounts that don't follow back, mutuals and more. The comparison runs on your device rather than on a server.

shareDataSafely.question: Is it safe to upload Instagram data download to third-party tools?
shareDataSafely.answer: Yes, if the tool keeps your file in your browser. SafeUnfollow reads your ZIP on your device, and the file stays in this browser. Anonymous page analytics and ad requests do leave it, but neither carries your file. Avoid trackers that ask for your Instagram password.

withoutPassword.question: How does SafeUnfollow work without my Instagram password?
withoutPassword.answer: SafeUnfollow works without your password because it reads Instagram's official data export instead of your account. You download your follower data as a ZIP from Meta Accounts Center, then select it here. Your browser reads the files inside and compares followers with following. It never calls Instagram's API.

betterThanPaid.question: Is SafeUnfollow better than paid Instagram unfollow apps?
betterThanPaid.answer: SafeUnfollow suits most people better, because the analysis is free, needs no Instagram login and runs in your browser. Exporting your filtered list as a file is a one-time unlock. Paid apps with real-time monitoring need access to your account, which breaks Instagram's Terms of Service.

mobileUse.question: Can I use SafeUnfollow on iPhone or Android?
mobileUse.answer: Yes. SafeUnfollow works in any mobile browser, including Safari, Chrome and Firefox on iPhone and Android. Request your export in the Instagram app, download the ZIP from Meta's email and select it at safeunfollow.app. Most of its visitors are on a phone, so the layout is built for phones first.
